label: VERIFIED
extraction: Plan-Orchestrate self-check validation before emitting. Checks: every agent in every chain from catalogue (after stripping ecc: prefix), resolved ORCH_CMD and AGENT use same form (never mixed), no annotations/instructions in output, no invented flags (--mode, --gate, --agents), task descriptions single-line double-quoted with escaped quotes, each starts with [Plan: path#step-id] includes Acceptance (1-3 items), Out of scope only when inherited, no duplicate agents in chain, chain length <=4, impl/refactor/migration end with reviewer-class agent, overview table lists every step, per-step detail block count matches resolved --scope. Large plan (>1500 lines): overview-only mode - emit only overview table, skip per-step blocks and Batch block. Edge cases: no clear steps (prefer H2/H3 splitting), step too broad (suggest split), plan declares agents (strip ecc: prefix first), polyglot project (lang=unknown -> code-reviewer/build-error-resolver).
